name: bricoloc
description: Ecosysteme numerique BRICOLOC - location de machines et outillage (Belgique)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build:shared && npm run db:reset --workspace @bricoloc/api
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @bricoloc/shared && npm run test --workspace @bricoloc/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @bricoloc/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @bricoloc/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @bricoloc/web
